table:accounts.rule: Erase every profile field and all account dates. Ever-active identities retain only id, deleted status and the fixed SQL name. Never-used invitations leave no row.

table:auth_links.rule: Erase every target link, including expired, revoked and consumed invitation/reset/recovery hashes.

table:auth_login_limits.rule: Remove the target current-email bucket and every unbound email bucket, including former emails. Keep other current-account buckets and source budgets. Held reservations cannot recreate removed rows.

table:auth_sessions.rule: Erase every target session, including live, expired and revoked hashes.

table:auth_tokens.rule: Erase every target API token, including expired or revoked entries.

table:cascade_members.rule: Erase members of erased workflow runs; retain surviving workflow history.

table:cascade_runs.rule: Erase children of erased workflows. Preserve runs in surviving workflows, including their initiator identities and stored text.

table:data_tables.rule: Erase target-owned datasets and generations by opaque owner identity. Independent outputs of other owners survive.

table:layer_tiles.rule: Erase tiles of erased maps and tiles with erased input evidence, regardless of map owner.

table:lineage_edges.rule: Erase children of erased workflows and target-owned outputs; preserve independent other-owner output lineage and retained actor identity.

table:map_history.rule: Erase children of erased maps; preserve original authors and times on surviving maps.

table:maps.rule: Erase maps owned by the target. Keep other owners maps, definitions, SQL homes and actor facts except recorded unfiling and evidenced derivative invalidation.

table:operation_jobs.rule: Erase target-owned jobs and children of erased workflows. Preserve other owners contained histories even when the erased person initiated or authored them.

table:original_account.rule: Keep the immutable original adoption marker and its opaque identity reference. Setup remains complete.

table:ownership_transfer_gate.rule: Drain transfer transactions; no target from/to reservation may survive completion.

table:pg_connections.rule: Erase target-owned connections including encrypted credential envelopes.

table:project_datasets.rule: Remove filings of erased datasets and dissolved projects. Preserve every other filing.

table:project_people.rule: Remove memberships of the target and all grants on dissolved owned projects.

table:projects.rule: Dissolve owned projects, remove grants and unfile surviving member-owned contents with exactly one recorded acting-admin revision.

table:recipes.rule: Erase workflows owned by the target. Keep other owners definitions, fixed homes, actor facts and independently owned outputs.

table:step_runner_outputs.rule: Erase target runner output associations and children of erased workflows. Preserve independent outputs owned by other runners.

table:workspace_settings.rule: Keep instance settings. Personal legacy settings were adopted into account_preferences.

file:metadata.rule: Compact live SQLite and truncate WAL after row erasure. Former values must be absent while control bytes survive.

file:tables.rule: Remove target generations, retired files, sketches and staging. Preserve other owners artifacts; await readers and failed unlinks.

file:tmp.rule: Remove target query/export/import scratch after work and stream settlement. Preserve unrelated work.

file:exports.rule: Remove target prepared project archives after claims or expiry settle. Preserve other initiators issued private copies for their lifetime.

file:tiles.rule: Remove owned and erased-input archives across owners, close open handles, and preserve unrelated archives.

file:tile-scratch.rule: Drain and remove target tile/query export candidates; preserve independent work.

file:thumbnails.rule: Remove target images and every image with erased dataset evidence across owners, including both themes and manifests. Unattributed other-owner images retain the documented residual.

file:thumbnail-inputs.rule: Remove evidence for erased thumbnails; preserve unrelated evidence.

file:tile-inputs.rule: Remove evidence for erased tiles; preserve unrelated evidence.

file:geocode.rule: Purge the whole answer cache for ever-active deletion. Fence late writes by generation. Invitations do not purge.

file:isochrone.rule: Purge the whole answer cache for ever-active deletion. Fence late writes by generation. Invitations do not purge.

file:overpass.rule: Purge the whole answer cache for ever-active deletion. Fence late writes by generation. Invitations do not purge.
